sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Taijutsu, Fire Release, Lightning Release

system.description:
You cover your hand or feet with plasma, before quickly striking a creature within range. Make a Melee ninjutsu (or taijutsu) attack against a creature within range. On a hit, you deal 5d6 fire damage and the target must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, you inject a mass of your chakra into them, as they begin to glow, being treated as a Starlight until the end of your next turn. This doesn’t count against your normal Starlight maximum.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3, the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, you can make a second attack against a different creature in range. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, you can make a third attack against a different creature from the previous two in range.
